reviewer.name: automated visual review of rendered slides

review_context.method: each slide image inspected at full resolution for clipping, overlap, alignment, legibility and factual captions; data slides (3, 5, 6, 7) checked against stats.json

findings.message: Confidence value wraps to three lines inside the left card; fully legible.
Lower third of both comparison cards is empty; text fully visible.
Fact-file row reads 3 valid kept, 3 valid rejected, 0 invalid kept, 10 invalid rejected, matching stats.json.
Bars 0.83 / 0.67 / 0.75 with intervals; legend above the axes; sidebar shows pooled values and McNemar p 0.125.
Decision grid: fact-file row rejects all perturbed and keeps glc_wt, mek1_wt (both executors) valid.
Empty band below the two cards; headings aligned.
